purpose: Gate priority-engine runtime work to an explicitly authorized, pinned disposable save whose actual bytes pass the canonical exact save/game version classifier. The current implementation can reach launcher proof only; the existing priority engine is a single-priority dispatcher, so full Land -> Survive -> Purchase -> Travel -> Sell behavior proof remains a successor runtime workflow.
allowedScope: read disposable-save policy, registry, and active pin
read the pinned save bytes through the canonical save-compatibility classifier
reject a pinned save unless its role and exact version are automation eligible
invoke the canonical launcher lifecycle without force-stopping an ambiguous or human-owned runtime
name the first priority-engine command without representing dispatch as behavior proof
write gitignored classification and launcher-gate result artifacts
forbiddenScope: mutate any save that is not the approved disposable pin
treat filename, calendar year, or registry cohort as version proof
force-stop an active or ambiguously owned Bannerlord session
blast multiple priority commands without same-run acknowledgement between them
claim observed priority-engine behavior from command dispatch alone
promote launcher or command acknowledgement into trade/runtime proof

successorGate.requiredBehavior: same-run ordered priority acknowledgements and fresh observed gameplay deltas before advancing through Survive, Purchase, Travel, and Sell

proofBoundary: This workflow currently proves only disposable-save admission plus the canonical launcher path. Exact save classification and launcher success are lower proof levels. Full priority-engine live-runtime certification remains unproven until a successor workflow observes the ordered five-stage behavior chain in the same run.
